cohort: The study included 3,857 consecutive, term, singleton pregnancies.
finding: An abdominal circumference (AC) in the >90th percentile at 28-34 weeks' gestation was found to be the best sonographic predictor of macrosomia at birth.
cross-section timing: Predictor measurements taken at 28-34 weeks of gestation.
gest_age: Term pregnancies; predictor measurements taken at 28-34 weeks of gestation.
